sn45.6:1.1: Sāvatthi nidānaṃ || || Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pa || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Brahmacariyam brahmacariyanti bhante vuccati || katamaṃ nu kho bhante brahmacariyam katamam brahmacariyapariyosānan ti || ||
sn45.6:2.1: Ayam eva kho bhikkhu ariyo {aṭṭhaṅgiko} maggo brahmacariyaṃ || seyyathīdaṃ || Sammādiṭṭhi || pa-pe || sammāsamādhi || || Yo kho bhikkhu rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo ||idam brahmacariyapariyosānan ti || ||
